scope: Independent static read-only engineering review; no data, ODE or training access

initial_findings.issue: Partially published checkpoint directories could block subsequent saves
initial_findings.response: Unique pending directory, atomic directory/pointer publication; orphan preservation with verified parent paths; fault injection tests added

initial_findings.issue: Interruptions could lose unsaved valid updates and lacked an explicit recovery boundary
initial_findings.response: Per-attempt sampler/CPU/CUDA RNG boundary; before-update and completed-step exceptions save safe state; Adam interruptions return to verified disk checkpoint with explicit rollback count; full failed state retained

initial_findings.issue: Equivalence reference must name the symbolic discovery loss rather than the 0098 L1-penalized objective
initial_findings.response: Documentation now explicitly names discover_closure.loss and preserves removal of coefficient L1

followup: Reviewer confirmed both P1 paths corrected and no new numerical blocker. Nonblocking pointer-publication bookkeeping window was identified; root added full-file verification of latest before reporting saved_step and a third interruption test.
root_decision: Accept engineering implementation after 35 CPU/CUDA regression tests passed; no scientific promotion
